experimental_setups.title: Arun B - Experimental Setups Development
strings: Developed a low-cost, speed-controllable optical chopper for laser experiments using Arduino and a BLDC motor. This chopper can produce maximum frequency pulses of 2.8 KHz at 12 V. Its frequency can be further increased with more slots in the disc.
